column1: # f049: boundaries set by hand from the clear words of the manuscript and the print only (no code value used)
2 189 195    # manuscript has "if" in clear where the print has "as": the run is "king of Sweden break in hither"
merge 4 5    # manuscript has "allways" in clear between two coded stretches; the print has no such word; the two stretches are scored as one against "persons and effects will be safe at Archangel"
9 720 725    # manuscript "awake" in clear = print "awaken": the run before it is "by recrimination and shall not"
10 726 727   # the one group between "awake" and "notions" is paired with the print's "their"
11 729 734   # manuscript "concernd" = print "concerned"; the manuscript's clear "the" before the run is not in the print: the run is "shame by seeming too much"
